title: Natural signed tensor-Hom comparison of arbitrary cochain complexes
statement:
Let $Y$ be a scheme in universe $t$, and $R$ a commutative-ring sheaf of universe $\max(u,t+1)$ on its small pro-etale site. Use module sheaves in that coefficient universe, the signed direct-sum total tensor $T$, and the recorded product Hom complex $C$ with its product projections [def-sf-integral-hom-reduction-models, def-pur-hom-complex]. For arbitrary unbounded complexes $P,I$, there exists a natural transformation in the coefficient complex $Q$,
$$\alpha_Q:T(C(P,I),Q)\longrightarrow C(P,T(I,Q)),$$
with the following equation on every object $U$, integers $a,b,p$, and local sections $v\in C(P,I)^a(U)$, $z\in Q^b(U)$, $x\in P^p(U)$:
$$\alpha_Q(v\otimes z)(x)=(-1)^{bp}v(x)\otimes z.$$
Both tensors mean the actual sheafified pure tensors inserted in their total summands, and the right side is transported by $(p+a)+b=p+(a+b)$. Thus each component satisfies the existing predicate IsSignedHomTensor. No flatness, injectivity, boundedness or finite support is required, and invertibility is not asserted.

proof.text: Use the existing evaluation-normalized chain tensor-Hom equivalence. Put C=Hom(P,I) and let ev:C tensor P to I be the inverse transpose of its identity. For each Q define psi_Q:(C tensor Q) tensor P to I tensor Q by associating to C tensor (Q tensor P), braiding Q past P, reassociating to (C tensor P) tensor Q, and applying ev tensor identity. Curry psi_Q to define alpha_Q.

source.place: paragraph 1: the Hom and finite-free coefficient construction, before invertibility

proof.text: Associator and braiding naturality and tensor functoriality show that (identity_C tensor g) tensor identity_P followed by psi_Q-prime equals psi_Q followed by identity_I tensor g. Naturality and injectivity of inverse currying give the natural transformation alpha. No resolution, boundedness or invertibility is used.

source.place: paragraph 1: the Hom and finite-free coefficient construction, before invertibility

proof.text: Evaluate the inverse transpose on the homogeneous generator (v tensor z) tensor x, where degrees are a,b,p. The associators have coefficient 1, the middle braiding contributes (-1)^(bp), and the normalized evaluation sends v tensor x to v(x). Thus alpha_Q has exactly the IsSignedHomTensor formula, with the canonical transport (p+a)+b=p+(a+b). Tensor functoriality moves the maps through total summand inclusions. This is valid for every site object and arbitrary unbounded complexes.

theorem signedHomTensorComparison_exists
    (P I : CochainComplex (Modules.{t, u} Y R) ℤ) :
    ∃ α : (totalTensor.{t, u} Y R).obj
          (homComplex.{t + 1, t, max u (t + 1), max u (t + 1)} (R := R) P I) ⟶
        (totalTensor.{t, u} Y R).obj I ⋙
          (homComplexFunctor.{t + 1, t, max u (t + 1), max u (t + 1)}
            (R := R)).obj (op P),
      ∀ Q, IsSignedHomTensor.{t, u} Y R P I Q (α.app Q)
